title: Audit the upstream Lean formalization of family 378 and decouple its algebraic core
objective: Rebuild the openai/math Lean development for family 378 at a pinned commit within declared resource limits, inventory the statement of OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.SqrtLogSpace.exact_count_and_sat and its trusted assumptions, and state, in our own Lean project, the purely algebraic counting theorem it rests on, reusing the verified building blocks in problems/eth/lean.
deliverables: Pinned upstream commit, toolchain, dependency manifest and exact build commands, with resource use
A semantic inventory of the top-level formal statement: machine model, input encoding, exponent, axioms and any trusted external assumptions
A Lean statement of the algebraic counting core with as many of its lemmas proved as the limits allow, and the remaining obligations listed
A separate critic's verdict on whether the formal statement says what Theorem 1.1 says
success_criteria: Build assurance and mathematical meaning are reported separately
No sorry, axiom or native_decide is accepted silently; each is listed
Statements proved in our project build with lake --wfail and are recorded in verification.json
stop_conditions: The upstream build exceeds 120 cumulative build minutes or 30 GiB of storage
At most one clean build attempt and one diagnosed retry
No paid provider calls, publication or external contact beyond the user-authorized repository work
